In detail

Heerstraße (Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf) is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 9,829 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 1,296 cases recorded for the year, close to the citywide average. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Wandroz currently rates Heerstraße (Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf) in Berlin, Germany as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Berlin, Germany, based on Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl). This source has no time-of-day breakdown, so this is one overall level rather than a separately measured day and night figure — see the note on this page before treating the day/night badges as independently measured.

Not separately. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl) publishes one figure per zone with no time-of-day split, so Heerstraße (Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf)'s day and night badges show the same underlying level rather than an independently measured night figure. Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.
